plugins.name: customerio
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Customer.io with the official MCP connector, plus skills and slash commands for Journeys, Pipelines, Design Studio, and SDK setup.

skills.name: customerio-design-studio
skills.description: Customer.io Design Studio. Use when the user wants to create, edit, review, or publish Design Studio emails, components, global styles, connected emails, or email accessibility/QA. Triggers: "Design Studio", "draft an email", "email component", "global styles", "publish connected email", "review this email".
skills.description_zh: 创建、编辑、审查与发布Customer.io Design Studio邮件、组件、全局样式及已连接邮件，并检查邮件可访问性和质量。

skills.name: customerio-journeys
skills.description: Customer.io Journeys. Use when the user wants to create, list, edit, or review automations, campaigns, broadcasts, one-time sends, profiles, people, customers, segments, newsletters, subscription topics, transactional messages, or in-app messages. Triggers: "list automations", "create a campaign", "win-back segment", "people who haven't opened", "find profiles", "transactional send", "in-app message".
skills.description_zh: 管理Customer.io Journeys自动化、营销活动、广播、一次性发送、个人资料、客户群、订阅主题、事务消息及应用内消息。

skills.name: customerio-pipelines
skills.description: Customer.io Data Pipelines (CDP). Use when the user wants to add or inspect sources, destinations, reverse ETL, database syncs, identify/track/page/screen calls, or data in/out integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, warehouses, ad audiences). Triggers: "add a JavaScript source", "Pipelines", "CDP", "destination", "reverse ETL", "identify and track", "send data to Salesforce".
skills.description_zh: 配置和检查Customer.io CDP数据管道的来源、目标、反向ETL与数据库同步，处理identify、track、page、screen事件和CRM、仓库及广告受众集成。

skills.name: customerio-sdk
skills.description: Customer.io SDK and app integration. Use when the user wants to install or troubleshoot JavaScript, Node, iOS, Android, React Native, Expo, or Flutter SDKs, sandbox testing, first send, Live Activities / Live Notifications, or going live. Triggers: "add Customer.io to my React Native app", "JS snippet", "iOS SDK", "sandbox", "test send", "go live", "Live Activities".
skills.description_zh: 安装和排查Customer.io网页、Node、iOS、Android、React Native、Expo与Flutter SDK，支持沙箱、首次发送、实时活动通知和上线。

skills.name: customerio
skills.description: Customer.io MCP bootstrap. Use for Customer.io, Journeys, CDP Pipelines, Design Studio, builder onboarding, sandbox testing, app integration, SDK setup, transactional messaging, billing, going live, sources, destinations, identify/track events, and fly.customer.io / cdp.customer.io errors. Trigger even when the user does not name MCP or Customer.io.
skills.description_zh: 作为Customer.io MCP初始化入口，处理Journeys、CDP、Design Studio、SDK、沙箱、事务消息、账单、来源目标与上线，并排查相关域名错误。
